contracts.signal: Major-customer disclosure in Simmtech's half-year report (filed 08-13-2026): revenue from SK Hynix KRW 71,870,467,981 in H1 2026 = 17% of consolidated revenue, up from KRW 44,644,659,857 (15%) in H1 2025 (+61% YoY) - the fastest-growing named customer. Simmtech's Xi'an subsidiary obtained SK Hynix quality certification and began supply in 2013. A future-receivables securitisation on SK Hynix receivables (KRW 279,042M over two years) backs a KRW 47,000M ABL loan issued 2025-04-29, KRW 23,500M outstanding at 2026-06-30.
contracts.value: KRW 71,870M = 17% of Simmtech H1 2026 revenue (H1 2025: KRW 44,645M / 15%)
